rocket/argon-high.judge1_note: Polished night launch with flames, smoke, liftoff, frame exit and reset, but countdown “1” is not visible.
rocket/argon-high.judge2_note: Rich scene with ring countdown, mission timer, searchlights, venting, spark ignition and a horizon glow that loops cleanly, though the rocket is tiny and its flame barely reads.

rocket/argon-low.judge1_note: Polished night scene with vivid ignition, smoke, rocket exit and reset; countdown 3 and accelerating climb are not clearly demonstrated.
rocket/argon-low.judge2_note: Ring countdown, searchlights, spark-filled ignition with flame and smoke, a quick climb with a sparkling trail and a smooth fade-in reset make it a polished loop.

rocket/argon-medium.judge1_note: Polished night launch with flames, smoke, liftoff, exit and reset, but countdown 2 is not visible in the sampled frames.
rocket/argon-medium.judge2_note: Countdown, searchlights, venting and a big ignition with sparks and a smoke column all work, but the flame glow is a crude orange ellipse.

rocket/astra-high.judge1_note: The countdown, fiery liftoff, rocket exit and loop are clearly visible, with polished night scenery but somewhat coarse smoke effects.
rocket/astra-high.judge2_note: Stylish mission-UI design with ring countdown, GO text, smoke plume, a climb off the top and a loop, but the engine flame is small and the UI dominates the frame.

rocket/astra-low.judge1_note: Polished night scene with flames, smoke, liftoff, frame exit and a visible reset, but countdown 3 is not shown.
rocket/astra-low.judge2_note: Clean HUD with countdown, flame, smoke, a fast climb off-screen and a loop, but the ignition and smoke are small and the cycle feels rushed.

rocket/astra-medium.judge1_note: Complete launch and loop with polished night scenery, flames, and smoke, though the countdown’s 2 is faint.
rocket/astra-medium.judge2_note: Ring countdown, flame, smoke, a climb off the top and a loop all work in a tidy but plain scene with only a small ignition.

rocket/sol-high.judge1_note: Polished night scene with flames, smoke, liftoff, frame exit and a clear reset; countdown 2 is not visible in the sampled frames.
rocket/sol-high.judge2_note: Polished HUD with ring countdown, LIFTOFF, flame, smoke trails, an exit off the top and a loop, though the ignition is fairly restrained.

rocket/sol-low.judge1_note: Countdown, ignition, liftoff, rocket exit and reset are visible; the polished night scene is slightly weakened by repetitive, oversized smoke blobs.
rocket/sol-low.judge2_note: Countdown, ignition glow, flame, liftoff and loop all work with neat status labels, but the twin parallel smoke columns look odd and the flame is modest.

rocket/sol-medium.judge1_note: All required elements are visible, with a clear countdown, fiery smoky launch, rapid climb out of frame, loop reset, and polished night scenery.
rocket/sol-medium.judge2_note: Clean, correct countdown, flame, smoke trail, climb off the top and loop, but it is fairly minimal and the ignition is modest.

lighthouse/argon-high.judge1_note: The beam sweeps visibly, rain persists, waves produce rock spray, and lightning illuminates the sky; the composition is strong, though clouds and rocks look somewhat blocky.
lighthouse/argon-high.judge2_note: Dramatic storm with a rotating double beam, heavy rain, layered waves spraying against the rocks, a cottage and a lightning flash, though the clouds are blobby and the scene is dark.

lighthouse/argon-low.judge1_note: Clear beam sweeps, continuous rain, crashing waves with spray, and sky-lighting lightning satisfy the brief, though angular rocks and repetitive wave lines limit polish.
lighthouse/argon-low.judge2_note: Best waves, with foamy crests crashing on the rocks, plus a rotating double beam, heavy rain and a sky flash, though the lightning bolts are scribbly squiggles.

lighthouse/argon-medium.judge1_note: The beam sweeps, rain persists, waves produce spray, and lightning illuminates the sky; the composition is strong, though water and rocks look simplified.
lighthouse/argon-medium.judge2_note: Atmospheric storm with a rotating double beam, heavy rain, misty spray crashing on the rocks, a cottage and a lightning sky flash, though the spray is a bit smudgy.

lighthouse/astra-high.judge1_note: The beam visibly sweeps, rain persists, waves produce spray against the rocks, and lightning brightens the sky in a polished 960×540 composition.
lighthouse/astra-high.judge2_note: Wave crest with spray at the cliff, rain and a visible bolt are present, but the beam sweeps a limited arc and the sky barely brightens.

lighthouse/astra-low.judge1_note: The sweeping beam, steady rain, crashing waves with spray, and sky-lighting lightning are visible in a well-composed 960×540 scene, though the water looks simplistic.
lighthouse/astra-low.judge2_note: Wave spray on the cliff and rain are good, but the beam is faint, the lightning flash is weak and the last frame is missing.

lighthouse/astra-medium.judge1_note: The beam sweeps visibly, rain persists, waves produce spray, and lightning illuminates the sky; the 960×540 composition is strong, though the sea and rocks look somewhat simplistic.
lighthouse/astra-medium.judge2_note: The beam sweeps the full arc down over the sea, with steady rain, repeated wave spray against the cliff, a cottage and a clear lightning flash.

lighthouse/sol-high.judge1_note: The beam sweeps visibly, rain persists, and lightning illuminates the sky, but crashing waves and spray lack force.
lighthouse/sol-high.judge2_note: The beam rotates through a full sweep over the sea and the lightning flash is clear, but the waves and spray are faint and the rain is light.

lighthouse/sol-low.judge1_note: The beam sweeps, rain persists, and lightning brightens the sky, but the waves show limited crashing motion despite visible rock spray.
lighthouse/sol-low.judge2_note: The beam sweeps clearly over a low-poly rock with rain and a sky flash, but the waves are a single squiggle with little spray and the lightning bolt is crude.

lighthouse/sol-medium.judge1_note: The beam visibly sweeps, rain persists, waves produce spray against the rocks, and lightning illuminates the well-composed 960×540 scene.
lighthouse/sol-medium.judge2_note: Strong lightning bolt with a full sky flash, cliff spray and a cottage, but the beam sweeps only through the upper arc and the rain is light.

hexagon/argon-high.judge1_note: The large hexagon visibly rotates, with 12 numbered balls piling and bouncing near the bottom without visible overlaps or escapes.
hexagon/argon-high.judge2_note: Rotating hexagon with spokes and 12 billiard balls that pile and roll correctly inside the walls, though the styling is simple.

hexagon/argon-low.judge1_note: The hexagon visibly rotates, all 12 numbered balls remain inside without visible overlap, and they settle along the bottom with polished presentation.
hexagon/argon-low.judge2_note: Glowing rotating hexagon with 12 numbered glossy balls that pile and roll without escapes or overlaps.

hexagon/argon-medium.judge1_note: The hexagon visibly rotates, and all 12 numbered balls remain contained without visible overlap while settling and shifting along the bottom.
hexagon/argon-medium.judge2_note: Attractive billiard-ball set of 12 numbered balls inside a rotating neon hexagon, piling and rolling convincingly with no escapes or overlaps.

hexagon/astra-high.judge1_note: The hexagon visibly rotates, all 12 numbered balls remain contained without visible overlap, and gravity produces convincing bottom piles in a clean presentation.
hexagon/astra-high.judge2_note: Rotating hexagon with 12 legible pastel numbered balls that settle and roll correctly, with no escapes or overlaps.

hexagon/astra-low.judge1_note: The hexagon visibly rotates, and all 12 numbered balls pile along the bottom without visible overlaps or escapes, with polished presentation.
hexagon/astra-low.judge2_note: Rotating hexagon with 12 legible numbered balls that settle and roll correctly along the lower walls.

hexagon/astra-medium.judge1_note: The hexagon visibly rotates, all 12 numbered balls remain inside without clear overlaps, and their bottomward piling convincingly shows gravity.
hexagon/astra-medium.judge2_note: Thin-line rotating hexagon with 12 legible numbered balls that pile at the low vertex and stay inside without overlapping.

hexagon/sol-high.judge1_note: The hexagon visibly rotates, all 12 numbered balls remain contained without visible overlap, and gravity produces convincing bottom piling and bouncing.
hexagon/sol-high.judge2_note: Rotating hexagon with 12 clearly numbered gradient balls that settle and roll along the lower walls, with no escapes or overlaps.

hexagon/sol-low.judge1_note: The large hexagon visibly rotates, all 12 numbered balls gather at the bottom without visible overlap or escape, and the presentation is polished.
hexagon/sol-low.judge2_note: Neon hexagon rotates with 12 balls piling realistically at the bottom and staying inside, but the balls are tiny and their numbers are illegible.

hexagon/sol-medium.judge1_note: The large hexagon visibly rotates, all 12 numbered balls remain inside without visible overlap, and the bottom piles convincingly suggest gravity in a polished presentation.
hexagon/sol-medium.judge2_note: Rotating neon hexagon with 12 clearly numbered pastel balls that pile and roll correctly, plus a tidy HUD.

octopus/argon-high.judge1_note: A charming, polished octopus with clear eyes and tentacles plausibly rides a complete bicycle, holding the handlebars and reaching a pedal.
octopus/argon-high.judge2_note: Outstanding, delightful illustration with an octopus in straw hat and glasses on the saddle, tentacles on the pedals and belled handlebar, a crab in the basket, a pinwheel, fenders and a chain.

octopus/argon-low.judge1_note: Charming, recognisable octopus sits on a well-drawn bicycle and grips the handlebars, though the pedals are indistinct.
octopus/argon-low.judge2_note: Richly detailed, charming octopus with a propeller cap riding a bike with fenders, basket, chain and saddle, with tentacles on the pedals and bars, though the bubbles on land are odd.

octopus/argon-medium.judge1_note: A charming, polished octopus with expressive eyes and curling tentacles plausibly rides a complete bicycle, gripping the handlebars and reaching the pedals.
octopus/argon-medium.judge2_note: Lively underwater scene with an expressive octopus on a detailed yellow bike (basket, chainring, chain, pedals), tentacles on bars and pedals, though the tentacles are a bit tangled.

octopus/astra-high.judge1_note: A charming, clearly recognisable octopus and well-formed bicycle, though contact with the saddle, handlebars and pedals is somewhat unclear.
octopus/astra-high.judge2_note: Expressive octopus on a beach with a well-drawn bike (fenders, brake cable, pedal), with tentacles on the bars and pedal, though the saddle is hidden.

octopus/astra-low.judge1_note: A charming, recognisable octopus rides a well-drawn bicycle, with tentacles reaching the handlebars and pedals, though its seating on the saddle is unclear.
octopus/astra-low.judge2_note: Cute scarfed octopus on a correct bike with chainring, pedals and handlebar, with tentacles placed on the bars and pedals in a tidy scene.

octopus/astra-medium.judge1_note: Charming, recognisable octopus on a well-formed bicycle, though its seating on the saddle is unclear.
octopus/astra-medium.judge2_note: Charming capped octopus with eight spotted tentacles gripping the handlebar and a pedal on a two-wheel bike, though the frame geometry is simplified and no saddle is visible.

octopus/sol-high.judge1_note: A charming, recognisable octopus on a well-drawn bicycle, though its contact with the saddle and pedals is slightly unclear.
octopus/sol-high.judge2_note: Polished, charming octopus on a spoked bike with a bell and chainring, with tentacles on the bars and pedals, though the tentacles showing through the wheels look a little odd.

octopus/sol-low.judge1_note: The octopus is clearly recognisable, the bicycle is complete, and tentacles engaging the handlebars and pedals make the charming scene convincingly readable.
octopus/sol-low.judge2_note: Cute scarfed octopus on a coherent bike with saddle, handlebar, chainring and pedals, with tentacles on the bars and pedals in a pleasant scene.

octopus/sol-medium.judge1_note: A charming, polished octopus with clear eyes and tentacles plausibly rides a complete bicycle, gripping the handlebars and reaching the pedals.
octopus/sol-medium.judge2_note: Appealing capped octopus seated on a bike with saddle, chainring and handlebar, with tentacles gripping the bars and a pedal.

rocket/opus-high.judge1_note: Clear countdown, fiery ignition, visible ascent and reset, and a polished night scene, though the smoke is overly diffuse.
rocket/opus-high.judge2_note: Polished ring countdown, LIFTOFF title, sparks, bright flame, side smoke and searchlights, with the rocket leaving the frame and resetting cleanly.

rocket/opus-low.judge1_note: All required elements are visible, but the dim countdown numeral and oversized blurred smoke reduce visual polish.
rocket/opus-low.judge2_note: Full 3-2-1 countdown, LIFTOFF text, flames, climb off-frame and clean loop under a moonlit starry sky, but the smoke is heavy opaque blobs and the rocket is small and plain.

rocket/opus-medium.judge1_note: The frames show the countdown, ignition, climb out of view and loop reset, with attractive night lighting but overly dense, repetitive smoke.
rocket/opus-medium.judge2_note: Countdown, glowing LIFTOFF, flame, a climb off the top and a loop all work, but the smoke is made of obvious overlapping flat discs that swamp the scene.

rocket/sonnet-high.judge1_note: Visible countdown, fiery smoky ignition, accelerating ascent out of frame, and loop reset satisfy the brief, though the faint ‘1’ and blurred smoke reduce polish.
rocket/sonnet-high.judge2_note: Strong sequence of T-minus ring, IGNITION/LIFTOFF labels, bright flame and glow, billowing smoke, a climb off-frame and a clean loop under a moonlit sky.

rocket/sonnet-low.judge1_note: Visible ignition, ascent, reset, and a detailed night sky earn credit, but countdown 1 and top exit are unconfirmed, while rectangular glow artifacts reduce polish.
rocket/sonnet-low.judge2_note: Countdown, a bright flame and big smoke clouds are present, but a hard-edged rectangular glow box clips around the rocket and the climb is slow, never clearly leaving the frame in the sampled frames.

rocket/sonnet-medium.judge1_note: Visible countdown, strong flames and smoke, accelerating liftoff and loop reset, with attractive night lighting but fairly simple rocket and scenery detail.
rocket/sonnet-medium.judge2_note: Countdown, LIFTOFF, flame, smoke, a climb off the top and a loop are all present, but the stick-like tower and sparse scene look basic.

lighthouse/opus-high.judge1_note: Sweeping light, steady rain, wave spray, and bright lightning are visible, but rectangular artifacts during the flash reduce visual polish.
lighthouse/opus-high.judge2_note: Beam sweeps with flares, rain and a bright lightning strike are shown, but the spray floats in open sea and a rectangular light-column artifact appears under the bolt.

lighthouse/opus-low.judge1_note: The beam sweeps, rain persists, waves produce spray, and lightning illuminates the sky; the 960×540 composition works, though the rendering is somewhat flat.
lighthouse/opus-low.judge2_note: A well-sweeping beam, rain, spray at the rock base and a vivid lightning flash work, but the waves are thin line strokes.

lighthouse/opus-medium.judge1_note: The beam visibly sweeps, rain persists, waves produce spray, and lightning illuminates the sky; the 960×540 composition is strong, though the spray looks artificial.
lighthouse/opus-medium.judge2_note: Rotating beam with flares, rain and a strong lightning flash are present, but the sea is nearly flat and the spray is bokeh-like dots, not waves hitting rocks.

lighthouse/sonnet-high.judge1_note: The sweeping beam, steady rain, wave spray, and sky-lighting lightning are visible, but the spray looks like translucent bubbles.
lighthouse/sonnet-high.judge2_note: Sweeping beam, rain, low-poly cliff with a cottage and a good lightning flash, but the spray is made of crude circle clusters.

lighthouse/sonnet-low.judge1_note: The beam sweeps, rain persists, waves produce spray, and lightning illuminates the sky; the composition is clear but visually simple.
lighthouse/sonnet-low.judge2_note: Beam rotation, rain, lightning flash and spray on the rock are present, but the wave is a crude flat wedge and the large dark rock dominates the composition.

lighthouse/sonnet-medium.judge1_note: Rain, a sweeping beam, and sky-brightening lightning are visible, but the spray does not clearly show waves crashing against rocks.
lighthouse/sonnet-medium.judge2_note: Beam sweep, rain and a clear lightning flash are present, but there are no real rocks, the spray appears in open water and the waves are flat line patterns.

hexagon/opus-high.judge1_note: The rotating hexagon contains 12 numbered balls that settle at the bottom without visible overlaps or escapes, with polished lighting and clear presentation.
hexagon/opus-high.judge2_note: Most polished look, with green felt, a thick glowing frame and 12 billiard balls that pile and roll convincingly inside the rotating hexagon.

hexagon/opus-low.judge1_note: The rotating hexagon contains 12 numbered, non-overlapping balls that fall and gather at the bottom, with clean overall presentation.
hexagon/opus-low.judge2_note: Physics is correct, with a rotating hexagon and 12 balls piling inside without overlap, but the gray styling is plain and the numbers are tiny.

hexagon/opus-medium.judge1_note: The large hexagon visibly rotates, all 12 numbered balls remain inside without visible overlap, and gravity produces clear bottom piling with polished visuals.
hexagon/opus-medium.judge2_note: Rotating glowing hexagon with 12 numbered pool-style balls that fall, pile and roll correctly, with an interaction hint.

hexagon/sonnet-high.judge1_note: The hexagon visibly rotates, all 12 numbered balls remain inside without visible overlap, and their bottom clustering convincingly suggests gravity.
hexagon/sonnet-high.judge2_note: Rotating glowing hexagon with 12 clearly numbered balls that pile and slide correctly, with no escapes or overlaps.

hexagon/sonnet-low.judge1_note: The hexagon visibly rotates, all 12 numbered balls remain inside without visible overlap, and their bottomward piling convincingly suggests gravity.
hexagon/sonnet-low.judge2_note: Rotating hexagon with 12 lively bouncing numbered balls that stay inside, but the styling is plain and the numbers are hard to read.

hexagon/sonnet-medium.judge1_note: The hexagon visibly rotates, all 12 numbered balls remain inside without visible overlap, and the bottom piles convincingly show gravity.
hexagon/sonnet-medium.judge2_note: Rotating hexagon with 12 numbered balls that fall and pile correctly inside, but the look is plain and the numbers are hard to read.

octopus/opus-high.judge1_note: A charming, recognisable octopus rides a well-formed bicycle with tentacles on the handlebars and pedals, though its seating on the saddle is unclear.
octopus/opus-high.judge2_note: Pink helmeted octopus riding a red bike with chain, pedals, saddle and handlebar, with tentacles placed correctly, but the drawing is fairly simple.

octopus/opus-low.judge1_note: A charming, recognisable octopus rides a well-formed bicycle, though its seating on the saddle is unclear.
octopus/opus-low.judge2_note: Basic flat drawing in which the octopus floats above a thin bike, with no visible pedals and only one tentacle on the handlebar.

octopus/opus-medium.judge1_note: A charming, recognisable octopus rides a well-drawn bicycle, though its contact with the saddle and pedals is slightly unclear.
octopus/opus-medium.judge2_note: Correct bike with saddle, chainring, pedals and handlebar, held by a pink helmeted octopus, but the drawing is simple.

octopus/sonnet-high.judge1_note: A charming, recognisable octopus rides a complete bicycle, though its contact with the saddle and pedals is slightly unclear.
octopus/sonnet-high.judge2_note: Flat cartoon with a helmeted octopus holding the handlebar and reaching the pedals of a red bike on a road, but it has few tentacles and basic, slightly off frame geometry.

octopus/sonnet-low.judge1_note: The octopus is charming and recognisable, with a convincing bicycle frame and wheels, but the handlebars, pedals and riding contact points are unclear.
octopus/sonnet-low.judge2_note: Simple flat drawing: the octopus has few tentacles and floats above the frame, and the bike lacks visible pedals and has only a vague handlebar.

octopus/sonnet-medium.judge1_note: A charming, recognisable octopus on a well-formed bicycle, though its seating position and handlebar grip are slightly unclear.
octopus/sonnet-medium.judge2_note: Clear flat octopus with eight tentacles sitting on the saddle of a red bike with handlebar, crank and pedal, but the style is plain and the grip on the bars is loose.
